name: CircleBadge
statusNote: Deprecated in Primer React and slated for removal in the next major; primer.style still documents it. Primer names no replacement component: callers are told to draw the octicon directly with their own styling. Build it only to match existing screens (Marketplace and integration logos).
summary: A large white disc with a soft shadow that frames a logo or octicon, used to connect third-party services visually. Do not choose it for new work.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: Diameter 56, 96 or 128px; ignored when size is set.

inputs.name: inline
inputs.description: Sit inline in text instead of as a block.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: A CircleBadge.Icon (an octicon) or an image, centred in the disc.

anatomy.name: Disc
anatomy.description: A circle of the given diameter in --bgColor-default with --shadow-resting-medium.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: CircleBadge.Icon: an octicon centred in the disc, no wider than 60% and no taller than 55% of it, keeping its aspect ratio.

layout.text: The disc is a square of side 56, 96 or 128px (small, medium, large), or the numeric size, with a 50% radius; its content is centred on both axes.
The icon is limited to 60% of the disc's width and 55% of its height, height auto.
Block by default (a flex box on its own line); inline makes it an inline box.

states.text: One static appearance; no hover, focus or press styling even when rendered as a link.

behaviour.text: Non-interactive by default (a div); a caller may render it as a link, which the module does not style.

accessibility.role: none (div); link when rendered as an anchor
semantics: The disc has no name; give the icon an aria-label (e.g. "Launch badge") or the image alt text.

notes.text: Primer's deprecation names no replacement component, so there is no replacedBy; GitHub's guidance is a plain octicon import with custom styling.
The three diameters are a JavaScript map, not tokens, and the icon limits are CSS percentages.
